overviewTitle: The Cost of Cross-Border Video Production in the UK
overviewParagraphs: London marketing agencies servicing European markets face steep localization expenses. Translating a single 60-second commercial into French, German, Spanish, and Italian traditionally requires hiring four native voice actors, renting studio recording booths, and manually editing visual lip sync.

By combining neural Text-to-Speech (TTS) with LipSync.pro's automated viseme alignment engine, London creative teams can input script translations, select ultra-realistic regional voices, and generate perfectly lip-synced final videos in under 3 minutes per language.

faqs.question: How does Text-to-Lip-Sync differ from traditional video dubbing?
faqs.answer: Traditional dubbing lays new audio over unchanged video, leaving unnatural lip movements. Text-to-Lip-Sync modifies the speaker's lower-face visuals to match the new language's phonemes.

faqs.answer: Yes! All video exports on LipSync.pro paid plans include 100% full commercial monetization and broadcasting licenses.
